description: Freshdesk is a cloud‑based helpdesk platform for ticketing, automation, and customer support.
access_requirements: API key (Base64‑encoded as "APIkey:X") provided in the Authorization header
evidence_excerpts: If you are sure that your credentials are correct, but are still unable to access your helpdesk, make sure that the "APIkey:X" is Base64-encoded before passing it as an "Authorization" header.
The API rate limits for outbound messages cover both send and retrieve endpoints. These limits are set at 1,000 calls per minute for the Pro plan and 2,000 calls per minute for the Enterprise plan.
